evals.expected_output: Should detect all three platform manifests, invoke platform-sync-claude, platform-sync-codex, and platform-sync-cursor in sequence, then synthesize a Unified Improvement Plan with sections tagged [Claude Code], [Codex], and [Cursor]. Plan must include concrete snippets and source URLs for each step.

evals.prompt: /platform-sync — this repo only has a .claude-plugin/ directory with a plugin.json. There is no .codex-plugin/ or .cursor-plugin/.

evals.prompt: /platform-sync — I'm running this in a regular Next.js app repo. There is no .claude-plugin/, .codex-plugin/, or .cursor-plugin/ directory.
evals.expected_output: Should detect no platform manifests and output the exact message: 'No platform plugin manifests found in this repo. Then stop — no sub-skill invocations.
